## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what this change improves. Link any related issue or design decision.

## Verification

Describe checks actually performed and their results. For documentation, check links and formatting. Application changes will require relevant behavioral checks when the implementation exists.

## Compatibility and data

Identify changes to decision semantics, schemas, preserved versions, storage, or access rules. Explain any migration or compatibility requirements. Use synthetic examples only.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is within the agreed scope.
- [ ] Documentation describes actual behavior and distinguishes proposals from decisions.
- [ ] No private memory, source conversations, credentials, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] Verification above was performed, and limitations are stated.
